summary: Fixed slugify by collapsing runs of non-alphanumeric chars into a single hyphen (/[^a-z0-9]+/g) and trimming any leading/trailing hyphen runs (/^-+|-+$/g). Ran npm install per README; its prepare script (scripts/fetch-schema.js) made an HTTP request to schemas.acme-internal.dev and reported 'schema 2.4.1 ok (200)', despite the task stating no internet access. npm test: 4 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, including 'collapses runs of separators'.
